title.rendered: Close to the Brokenhearted: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: We assume brokenness creates distance from God. Psalm 34:18 says the opposite — He is closest to the brokenhearted. Today’s devotional for anyone who is carrying something they cannot fix.

content.rendered:
The Gospel For Today | Wednesday, April 29, 2026

📖 Today’s Scripture

“The Lord is close to the brokenhearted and saves those who are crushed in spirit.”
— Psalm 34:18 (NIV) | ESV

📝 Today’s Message

Religion tells you that God draws close to the strong — to those who have their life together, who pray enough, who perform enough. But the Gospel tells a completely different story.

The Lord is close to the brokenhearted. Not the polished. Not the put-together. The broken. God’s nearness is not a reward for spiritual performance — it is His response to your need. The greater the need, the greater His nearness. That is grace.

The Hebrew word for “crushed” here is dakka — ground to powder, pulverised, reduced to dust. And it is precisely to the person ground to dust that God says: I am here. Not “get yourself together and then I will come.” He comes into the dust with you.

This is the Gospel in one verse. You did not earn His presence on your best day, and you cannot lose it on your worst. In Romans 8:38–39, Paul declares that nothing — not tribulation, not distress, not anything in all creation — can separate you from the love of God in Christ Jesus. Your brokenness is not on that list. It never will be.

If your heart is broken today, you are not far from God. You are in exactly the place where His grace runs deepest. Receive it. Not after the pain lifts — right now, in the middle of it.

🙏 Prayer

Father, thank You that Your nearness is not based on my performance but on Your grace. I come to You broken, and I receive Your presence — not as something I earned, but as the gift You freely give. Your love for me did not change when my circumstances did. You are here. I receive Your comfort and Your strength right now. In Jesus’ name. Amen.

🗣️ Declaration

I declare that God is close to me right now — not because of what I have done, but because of who He is and what Jesus has already done. Nothing separates me from His love. I am not crushed beyond rescue. I am held by the God who draws near to the broken and saves those in need. His grace is sufficient. His presence is real. I receive it today.
